content: Mikołaj Firlej (1588–1635) was a Polish nobleman and statesman. He served as the voivode (governor) of the Sandomierz Voivodeship from 1624 to 1635. Firlej came from the Firlej family, a prominent Polish noble family. He participated in Polish politics and government during the reign of Sigismund III Vasa, the King of Poland and Sweden. However, beyond these basic facts, I do not have enough confidence in additional details about Mikołaj Firlej's life and career to include them without caveats. My knowledge about this historical figure is limited.
